content: आङ्ग {%a.%} (-गी|{%f.%}) [अङ्ग-स्वार्थे-अण्] .²1 Bodily, corporeal. .²2 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) Relating to the base (अङ्ग). .²3 Having limbs or parts. .²4 Relating to the minor personages in a drama. .²5 Belonging to a portion of the Vedas. .²6 Produced or born in the country of the Aṅgas. .{@-गः@} A prince of the Aṅga country. .{@-गम्@} A delicate body.
